files.change: Clamp ZIP timestamps to representable DOS date bounds.
Add archive-test flate2 dependency and describe native adapters with excluded shell i18n library.
Use reversible path conversion for global directory arguments.
Exclude unresolved embedded inherited shell source; refuse filter-branch explicitly before mutation.
Keep pattern-file bytes separate from the argv escape representation.

Retain raw index and worktree filename bytes throughout staging.

Implement bounded native upload-archive server with request, repository, ref and format restrictions. Dispatch native SSH/Git remote archive requests, use client format inference and server policy, and honor explicit service responses and failures.
Connect native upload-archive handler.
Render reference selectors according to symbolic and abbreviation options, effective configuration, root refs, and ordered ambiguity diagnostics.
Connect native upload-archive service to command dispatch.
Distinguish encoded invalid argv bytes from real private-use Unicode; decode global directory paths.

files.origin: Independently authored Gitr archive interoperability and failure regressions with explicitly configured generated test-service shims; MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Gitr regression for explicit filter-branch refusal before mutation, under Apache-2.0.
Independently authored Gitr differential reference-selector tests against an external pinned Git oracle; MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Gitr native archive-service conformance tests, under the imported workspace Apache-2.0 license.

files.change: Exclude unresolved inherited shell i18n library; retain native dispatch wrappers, add upload-archive adapter and isolated helper-cache generation.
Reject missing required descendants before destructive repack/pruning; add SHA-1/SHA-256 regressions.
Expose byte-preserving normalized pathspec parsing and cover its boundary cases.
Emit upload-archive ACK framing with a separate flush before data sidebands. Stream upload-archive ACK/sideband replies into a writer while validating status, framing, progress, and fatal errors.
Cover upload-archive ACK/flush framing. Add streaming archive reply tests for payload/progress separation, malformed or truncated replies, and writer errors.
Check reftable expected values under the publication lock; release file locks after parse/hook errors; add regressions.
Use the already locked Rustix 1.1.5 process feature on Unix for safe archive process-group cleanup.

files.origin: Independently authored Gitr Rust remote-archive request coordination and process lifecycle support; MIT OR Apache-2.0.

files.change: Run upload-archive through the Git transport without upload-pack negotiation, checking proxy completion and cleaning up failures.
Isolate archive proxy process groups, terminate failed descendants, and preserve checked exit status without reusing a reaped leader PID.
Expose the native remote archive request API.
Stream SSH and explicit local archive services with bounded diagnostics, isolated process cleanup, and checked service termination.
Include valid symbolic aliases in ref selectors and omit missing, cyclic, or malformed targets without dropping valid refs.
Preserve Unix filename bytes during index/worktree path normalization.
